definition_zh: 制动过程作用于车辆或轮轨系统的力。
usage_overview: 在车辆与轮轨系统动力分析中，作为外部作用用于考察制动对轮轨纵向相互作用的影响，以及与系统其他方向动力响应的耦合关系。
translation_note: 本词条含依据文献语境拟定的参考译名。

P073.title: A coupling method for wheel–rail longitudinal interaction
P073.authors: L Pan, L Xu, X DU
P073.label: Pan等（2025）

complete_examples.text: In order to analyze the system dynamics with consideration of the braking force, a new longitudinal wheel–rail interaction model is proposed in this paper.

With the proposal of vehicle–track coupling dynamics, the train longitudinal dynamics further considers the influence of track structure vibration (Ju et al., 2007; Tran et al., 2016), but it is also limited to two-dimensional model, which cannot describe the influence of traction/ braking force on the lateral/vertical vibration response of the system.
